timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp. Normally UTC with offset (Z or +00:00). Rows stored before scripts/migrate_timestamps.py was run may lack an offset; treat those as UTC.

input.description: Attacker-typed text. Render as text only.

cmd_key.description: Present once the command has been grouped (new rows immediately; older rows after scripts/backfill.py or API start-up). Links to /api/commands/groups/{key}.

items.description: ATT&CK technique id, e.g. T1082 or T1110.001. Heuristic tag, not a confirmed technique.

techniques.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique ids matched by the rule set in app/mitre.py (heuristic). Absent on rows stored before the MITRE backfill ran.
